one_line: OpenAI pushes policy, AI firms raise billions, strategic acquisitions expand, new benchmarks and satellite test AI capabilities.

themes.title: OpenAI launches post‑midterm policy push
themes.text: OpenAI will begin a policy and public‑relations campaign after the U.S. midterm elections, advocating mandatory safety safeguards, speed limits on advanced AI, and rebranding its data centers as AI compute campuses. The initiatives will be introduced during the lame‑duck congressional session starting Nov. 9.

stories.headline: OpenAI to launch post‑midterm policy push, propose AI speed limits and rename data centers

themes.title: AI firms secure major funding rounds
themes.text: OpenAI lowered its fundraising target to $20 billion, down from $30 billion, while maintaining a $1.25 trillion valuation and has secured $11 billion so far. Hex Technologies raised $100 million Series D at a $1.2 billion valuation, Anthropic aims to raise up to ¥552.9 billion in its U.S. IPO, Vera Health secured $28.5 million Series A, Casap obtained $56 million Series B, and Bites raised $40 million Series A, all to expand AI‑focused products.

stories.headline: OpenAI cuts fundraising target by $10 billion, seeks $20 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation
Hex Technologies raises $100 million Series D, launches Hex 4.0 for AI agents
Anthropic to raise up to ¥552.9 bn ($3.5 bn) from Japanese investors in US IPO
Vera Health raises $28.5 million Series A to expand AI-powered clinical search platform
Casap raises $56 million Series B to expand AI dispute and fraud tools for banks
Bites raises $40 million Series A to expand AI‑driven frontline training platform

themes.title: Strategic acquisitions reshape AI services
themes.text: Saudi Aramco acquired a 49% stake in Saudi AI firm Humain, contributing about $2.6 billion in cash and AI assets while the Public Investment Fund retains a 51% controlling interest. ServiceNow bought Israeli startup Sweep for an undisclosed sum estimated at hundreds of millions of dollars to accelerate CRM migrations.

stories.headline: Saudi Aramco buys 49% of AI startup Humain, adds $2.6 billion cash
ServiceNow acquires Israeli startup Sweep to speed CRM migrations

themes.title: New AI benchmarks and satellite test
themes.text: SemiAnalysis released the GDPx benchmark, testing 206 agentic tasks across 11 professional domains, where Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 achieved the highest average score of 12.0%. Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite ran the Gemma 4 language model on a data‑centre‑class TPU and returned a haiku during its first ground‑station pass, and SEMICON Europa will convene experts in Munich to discuss advanced packaging and AI‑driven fab management.

stories.headline: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx benchmark; Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scores 12%
Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite generates first AI response in orbit
Semicon Europa 2026 focuses on advanced packaging and AI-driven fab management
